rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history or criminal background checks in advertising, applications, tenant selection or decisions. Unlawful acts include: inquiring about criminal history; advertising that people with records will not be considered; refusing to rent or terminating a tenancy based on criminal history; requiring disclosure or authorization to release criminal history; demanding a higher deposit or rent based on criminal history; refusing to add an immediate family member based on that person's criminal history; and disqualifying people from rental assistance programs such as Section 8 based on criminal history. Before taking any action based on criminal history, a landlord must give the applicant or tenant written notice and an opportunity to respond.
rules.key_value: Administrative fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation; civil damages of actual damages or 3x one month's rent; punitive damages; attorneys' fees and costs; injunctive relief. Written notice and opportunity to respond required before adverse action.

Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley, with exemptions for owner-occupied 1-3 unit properties and certain other situations.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt: owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units in which an owner of record lives in one unit as their primary residence.

rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record resides in one unit as their primary residence; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back (BMC 13.76.130 A.9); units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.effective_date_note: The passages give the Council passage date (April 14, 2020) but no effective date.

rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.review_note: Based on a Rent Board summary page, not the ordinance text. Status assumed in force because the page describes it as current.
rules.source_notes: The penalties and written-notice requirement come from other passages of the same Rent Board page (p1, p9).
